label: Access to services
rationale: These four responses are about whether a person can reach the service at all: no internet or smartphone, repeated retelling across teams, what happens when an application is refused, and unreliable rural broadband. SYN-0002 is included even though it never uses the word online, which is the kind of response a phrase list is expected to miss.

label: Workforce capability
rationale: These four are about the people who would operate the service: covering vacancies, when training is delivered, whether newer staff can spot a wrong output, and whether disagreeing with a recommendation is permitted.

label: Data governance
rationale: These four are about the handling of the data itself: re-identification through context, lawful basis against proportionality, retention and contractor copies, and which body is the controller after sharing.

label: Accountability
rationale: These three are about who answers for an outcome: a responsible officer who exists only in the diagram, whether an explanation is one a person can act on, and unclear ownership between teams and a supplier.

label: Procurement and reuse
rationale: These three are about buying and reusing: a specification written around one product, exit and export terms agreed before signature, and not knowing what other departments already hold. SYN-0015 mentions a supplier but is about accountability, so it is deliberately excluded here.

label: Environmental cost
rationale: Both responses are about the environmental accounting: an impact assessment that omits the electricity of the computation, and whether reduced mileage survives once processing and storage are counted.
